name: My Lewd Therapy
source:
A wild, explicit visual novel that throws you right into the sexiest side of the pro hero world. You’re not just another therapist—you’re the one with a quirk that turns every session into a steamy, unforgettable encounter. 

[From [url=https://naughty-narratives.itch.io/my-lewd-therapy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部狂野、露骨的视觉小说，带你进入职业英雄世界最性感的一面。你不仅仅是另一位治疗师，你还有一个怪癖，可以将每次治疗都变成一次热情洋溢、令人难忘的邂逅。

[来自[url=https://naughty-narratives.itch.io/my-lewd-therapy]itch.io[/url]]
